title: Sales Concessions and the Price Basis of a Builder Extended Rate Lock Loan Limit
content:
Builder incentives granted on a purchase above set shares of the contract price reduce the price basis on which a Builder Extended Rate Lock's resized loan limit is set.

**Guideline.** The incentive share is the builder incentives granted on the buyer's Home Purchase Agreement ledger as a percent of the contract price. Where it is above 6.0 percent, the whole of the incentives above 6.0 percent of the contract price is taken off the contract price to form the price basis; where it is above 2.0 percent up to 6.0 percent, half of the incentives above 2.0 percent of the contract price is taken off; otherwise the price basis is the contract price.

## Method by incentive share

| Incentive share | Price basis |
|---|---|
| 2.0 percent or less | the contract price |
| above 2.0 percent, up to 6.0 percent | the contract price less half of the incentives in excess of 2.0 percent of the contract price |
| above 6.0 percent | the contract price less all of the incentives in excess of 6.0 percent of the contract price |

## Worked cases (hypothetical inputs, contract price USD 500000.00)

| Incentives granted | Share | Excess | Price basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 10000.00 | 2.0 percent | none | USD 500000.00 |
| USD 20000.00 | 4.0 percent | 10000.00 over 2.0 percent; half is 5000.00 | USD 495000.00 |
| USD 30000.00 | 6.0 percent | 20000.00 over 2.0 percent; half is 10000.00 | USD 490000.00 |
| USD 40000.00 | 8.0 percent | 10000.00 over 6.0 percent | USD 490000.00 |
